verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a registered agent service: it will legally change your registered agent in your incorporation state. Accepting service of process at an in-state address is the core duty of that role. The evidence never mentions service of process, a staffed street office, or scanning legal documents into the account, let alone same-day. The separate physical-address mail-scanning feature is a related but different product and is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit service-of-process handling, a documented real street office, same-day scan-and-upload of served documents, notification of receipt, and independent corroboration.
